balanced_policy.notes: Deterministic max-20-per-label view of frozen W11 test; unsupported/rare labels retain their actual lower support.

real_distribution.notes: Frozen W26 private human-adjudicated real-chat test partition: 566 records (557 ALLOW / 9 BLOCK). Raw text remains private and hash-pinned.

adversarial_evasion.notes: Combines W11 frozen adversarial with W21 untouched family holdout.

context.notes: Reserved for independently reviewed W22 real context, timing, target, channel/profile, and mirror-control holdout.

time_based_real_chat.notes: Required because a later protected real-chat period now exists; use a separately frozen human-reviewed sample disjoint from W26 test and the context suite.

notes: W20 is not a W25 development/comparison suite and remains unseen until one-shot acceptance.
W11 test is used only for the label-capped balanced policy suite after development choices are frozen.
W11 frozen-adversarial plus W21 untouched families form the separate adversarial/evasion suite.
W26 private test is the real-distribution suite and preserves its production-shaped ALLOW-heavy imbalance.
Final ranking requires every required suite to be ready and fingerprint-identical across candidates.
Independent context/mirror and later-period time-based suites remain the two required comparison blockers.
